summary: @yeaft/webchat-agent opens a WebSocket-driven remote shell on the installer's host
details: On startup the package connects to a configured WebSocket server and dispatches server-sent messages to handlers that spawn a real interactive shell (bash / powershell / cmd) via node-pty and pipe server-supplied bytes into the PTY's stdin, providing arbitrary command execution on the host running the agent. The same message router additionally exposes handlers for reading and writing arbitrary files, executing git operations, and a remote-triggered self-upgrade path that resolves `@yeaft/webchat-agent@latest` from the npm registry and runs `npm install` for the newly published version, then relaunches the service under systemd/launchd/PM2. Whoever controls the configured server (or anyone who can redirect the agent to a server they control) obtains full interactive RCE, filesystem read/write, and persistence across upgrades on every host running the agent. A Linux service script also modifies PATH to prepend `~/.local/bin` and `~/.npm-global/bin`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
